description: Noise generator whose sample rate you set, modulate or clock, with six noise types

params.text: Sets how often a new noise sample is generated; at the top of its range that is the patch's own sample rate
Attenuverter for the Sample Rate CV input, -1 to +1
Sets how far a fresh random amount shifts the sample rate each time a new sample is generated
Attenuverter for the Flux CV input, -1 to +1
Selects the noise type: White, LFSR, Gray, Pink, Brown or Gaussian
Attenuverter for the Mode CV input, -1 to +1
Fast runs the generator across its full rate range; Slow divides that rate by 100 for modulation speeds
Stepped jumps to each new sample; Slewed interpolates linearly between samples, which doubles as a low-pass filter at audio rates
DC passes the output as generated; AC strips any DC offset out of it

inputs.text: A rising edge here generates one new sample, replacing the internal rate clock
Modulates the generation rate, scaled by the Sample Rate attenuverter
Modulates the flux amount, scaled by the Flux attenuverter
Modulates the noise type, scaled by the Mode attenuverter

notes: the generation rate is set as a fraction of the patch's own sample rate, so changing the patch's sample rate changes the speed and the sound of what comes out.
